evidence.observation: Purge brought exhaust O2 from ~28,800 ppm to 15 ppm; it stayed at 3-6 ppm through ramp and growth
Thermocouple tracked the ramp setpoint within ~1 °C; a brief overshoot to 760.7 °C at growth start settled to 749.8-750.2 °C
Heater power settled at ~47% during the hold (86% at end of ramp), which is consistent with holding a steady temperature
Ar flow within 1 sccm of the 100 sccm setpoint
Pressure steady at ~3.03 Torr, the same as during the ramp

args.missing_evidence: No characterization of the sample yet (e.g. Raman or optical imaging after cooldown). No normal-run reference ranges were provided, so heater power can't be checked against a baseline.
